name: Moonglade
summary: Moonglade is an introductory rite of passage for young night elf druids learning to commune with the sacred lands of Kalimdor. Guided by Mathrengyl Bearwalker in Darnassus, novices learn the spell to magically transport themselves across the world into Moonglade to meet Dendrite Starblaze in Nighthaven. This marks the beginning of their spiritual journey toward mastering the strength of the bear form.

sections.title: A Sacred Refuge
sections.body: Moonglade stands apart from the rest of Azeroth as an ancient sanctuary dedicated to the teachings of Cenarius. Under the watchful stewardship of Keeper Remulos, its tranquil groves provide peace and deep communion with nature. For a young druid, learning to project one's spirit across the land into Moonglade via the teleportation spell is a critical step, granting constant access to the heart of druidic wisdom regardless of mortal distances.

sections.title: Politics of the Circle
sections.body: While Moonglade is open to all who walk the path of the wild, it is not free of tension. A growing rift divides Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm in Darnassus and Keeper Remulos in Moonglade over the stewardship of nature and the creation of Teldrassil. Despite these philosophical fractures within the Cenarion Circle, young acolytes are still welcomed unconditionally into the haven of Nighthaven to pursue their sacred studies.

sections.title: The Path of the Bear
sections.body: Arriving in Nighthaven brings the novice before Dendrite Starblaze, an elder tasked with guiding fledglings along the ways of the Claw. Before any initiate can claim the mantle of the bear, they must be immersed in its perspective: endurance, fury, and unyielding defense of the wild. Starblaze receives each new student with reverent deference to Father Cenarius, commencing the trials of the Great Bear Spirit.

faq.q: Why do druids learn to teleport to Moonglade?
faq.answer: Teleporting to Moonglade connects a druid directly to the heart of their order. Because training, communion with spirits, and high-level council take place in Nighthaven, having an instantaneous spiritual conduit ensures every practitioner can return to study and replenish their spiritual energies.

Dendrite Starblaze is an elder druid stationed on the upper floor of a major lodge in Nighthaven. He oversees initiates arriving in Moonglade, initiating their trials to master animal perspectives—starting with the primal spirit of the bear.

faq.q: What tensions exist between Fandral Staghelm and Keeper Remulos?
faq.answer: Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm led the planting of Teldrassil without the blessing of the Dragon Aspects, pursuing a more aggressive, nationalistic posture for the night elves. Keeper Remulos and traditionalists in Moonglade remain dedicated to the ancient, neutral ways of Cenarius, creating ideological friction within the Cenarion Circle.

faq.q: Can Horde druids visit Moonglade as well?
faq.answer: Yes. Moonglade is a neutral haven protected by Keeper Remulos and the Cenarion Circle. Both night elf and tauren druids are welcome in Nighthaven to study the wild ways together, setting aside factional hostility while under the peace of Cenarius.

faq.q: What happens after reaching Dendrite Starblaze?
faq.answer: Once you report to Dendrite Starblaze, he guides you into the ritual trial of the Great Bear Spirit. This spiritual confrontation tests your resolve and understanding before you are permitted to harness the raw power of the bear.

faq.q: Where in Nighthaven is Dendrite located?
faq.answer: Dendrite Starblaze is located inside the main night elf lodge near the center of Nighthaven, standing watch on the second floor balcony overlooking the village.

angles.text: This journey represents your awakening to global druidic heritage, giving you an eternal lifeline to the tranquil heart of the Cenarion Circle.
Leaving Teldrassil's boughs for ancient Moonglade connects young kaldorei directly with the ancestral homeland preserved before the Great Sundering.
While Darnassus champions the Alliance, stepping into Moonglade reminds night elf druids of an older, higher calling that transcends worldly factions.
